hero.description: A calm place to shape your Markdown documents and see exactly how they will read when they leave the screen — with a pagination engine that predicts real page breaks before you print.
hero.footnote: No account required. Your documents stay in your browser.

features.title: Everything you need to shape a document
features.description: From the first keystroke to the printed page.

fidelity.title: Fidelity-first preview
fidelity.description: A pagination engine measures every block — paragraphs, lists, code, blank space — and predicts exact page breaks.

modes.title: Three editing modes
modes.description: Markdown source, WYSIWYG document editor, and paper preview. Switch freely — edits stay in sync.

paperSizes.title: Real paper sizes
paperSizes.description: A4, A5, Letter, and Legal with accurate margins, footers, and block spacing. Zoom in and out.

printReady.title: Print-ready
printReady.description: Browser print output matches the preview page for page.

pagination.title: Paper-accurate pagination
pagination.description: Paragraph, list, and code-block strategies with page-break markers synced to the editor scroll.

workspaces.title: Document workspaces
workspaces.description: Folders and documents with drag and drop, rename, move, delete, and per-folder icons and colors.

localFirst.title: Local-first
localFirst.description: Documents persist in IndexedDB. Works fully without an account.

cloudSync.title: Optional cloud sync
cloudSync.description: Sign in and keep your workspace in the cloud — PostgreSQL plus Cloudflare R2.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: Light, dark, and more themes with smooth transitions.

responsive.title: Responsive
responsive.description: Split desktop view, bottom navigation on mobile.

accessibility.title: Accessible
accessibility.description: Keyboard-resizable sidebar, ARIA-labeled controls, focus-visible styles.

create.title: Create and preview
create.description: Create a Markdown file and see the same content in Document and Preview modes.
create.alt: Creating a Markdown file and viewing it in Document and Preview modes

organize.title: Organize files and folders
organize.description: Move files and folders inside the on-device workspace with drag and drop.
organize.alt: Moving files and folders inside the on-device workspace

cloud.title: Move folders and files between Local and Cloud
cloud.description: Move your folders and Markdown files from Local to Cloud and back again.
cloud.alt: Moving a folder or Markdown file between Local and Cloud

desktop.title: Desktop workspace
desktop.description: The desktop layout keeps the file tree, editor, and paper preview visible together.
desktop.alt: Desktop dashboard with editor and paper preview

mobile.title: Mobile workspace
mobile.description: The responsive layout switches to focused file and preview sections with bottom navigation.
mobile.alt: Mobile dashboard with on-device and cloud-synced workspace navigation

pageBreak.title: Page-aware preview
pageBreak.description: The editor marks possible page breaks while you work, keeping the printed result predictable.
pageBreak.alt: Possible page break indicator in the document editor

tech.title: Built for precision
tech.description: A pragmatic stack, from editor to database.

footer.description: A calm place to shape your Markdown documents — pagination engine included.
